newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT EASES VS DLR, BCE MARK FUTURES END LOWER.
newsitem.headline: FORINT EASES VS DLR, BCE MARK FUTURES END LOWER.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed little changed against the dollar on Friday in what dealers said was a quiet day on the interbank forex market.
"There were hardly any deals today," said Adam Szilagyi of ABN-AMRO Bank.

The forint closed at 154.05/12 against the dollar compared with its opening of 154.11/16 and remained firmly on the National Bank of Hungary's bid, which at midday's close stood at 154.04 for the U.S. unit.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, German mark futures ended lower for all five maturities, the Ecu and the Swiss franc dropped for two termins.
Total turnover, of which Ecu futures gave the half, eased to 751.5 million forints from Thursday's 899.1 million.
